title: How many more: the difference between two bars
question: Kavya has 4 times as many stickers as Lily. They have 175 stickers altogether. How many more stickers does Kavya have than Lily?

relations.from: Kavya has 4 times as many stickers as Lily

asked.label: How many more stickers Kavya has than Lily

timeline.say: Kavya has 4 times as many stickers as Lily. They have 175 stickers altogether. How many more stickers does Kavya have than Lily?

timeline.text: 4 times as many stickers as Lily
timeline.say: Kavya has 4 times as many stickers as Lily.
Kavya has 4 times as many, so her bar is 4 units.
Kavya has 3 more units than Lily. That is what we want.
Pause and think. How many units are there altogether?
So 1 unit is 175 divided by 5, which is 35.
Lily has 1 unit, which is 35 stickers.
Kavya has 3 more units. 3 times 35 is 105.
Let's check: 140 and 35 make 175 altogether. It works!

timeline.text: Kavya has 105 more stickers than Lily.
timeline.say: So, Kavya has 105 more stickers than Lily. Well done!
